svg.aria-label: What happens after you launch: the product goes into the town; residents come across it, notice it, decide for themselves whether to open it, use it in their own situation, tell others afterwards, and it all rolls up into one plain page. Rules decide who comes across it and who notices; the residents decide everything else.

g.text: Each dot is one resident of the town, 201 in all. The counts come from a real run on a development instance
(a sample dinner-ideas app): people in this simulated town, not a forecast of a real market.
